Unpaired blocks put 0.1 at 69% persistence (199 of 288) against 76% for 0.05 (228 of 300), while five same-seed pairs gave 0.1 44 of 60 against 36. Expect: persistence within 2 of the block per 12 (no cost of 0.1), alignment lower on 0.05 in 8 of 12.
